grade_and_subject.official_subject_name: Name exactly as the state publishes it
grade_and_subject.organization: by_grade | by_course  (high school may be by course, see decision D1)

courses.grade_placement_label: A if the state officially assigns the grade, otherwise C ('typical, not official')

sections.assessment_notes: Only what the state officially provides, with citation_ids. Otherwise null.

_instructions.labels: A = official state standard. B = official IB framework or programme requirement. C = suggested alignment, unit idea, bridge or summary written by us (never official).

envelope.schema_version: Template version this document follows. Currently 0.1.0 (draft until Phase 1 finalizes it).
envelope.doc_id: Unique id, derived from the path. Examples: fl.grade-03.ela, az.grade-03.ela, ib.pyp.grade-03.ela, ib.dp-cp.grade-11.ela, xw.grade-03.ela. Kindergarten uses 'kindergarten'. The build script rejects an id that does not match the file path.
envelope.doc_type: state_standards | ib_alignment | crosswalk | summary | source_log | meta.
envelope.system: florida | arizona | ib | crosswalk. null only for summary, source_log and meta documents.
envelope.programme: null for Florida, Arizona, crosswalk. For IB: PYP (K-5), MYP (6-10) or DP_CP (11-12).
envelope.subject: ela | mathematics | science | social-studies. Arizona calls social studies 'History and Social Science'; keep the slug and record the official name in sections.grade_and_subject.
envelope.status: not_started | in_progress | drafted | reviewed | approved. Above not_started needs at least one citation.
envelope.content_labels: List of A, B, C present in the document. Florida/Arizona docs: A and C only. IB docs: B and C only. Crosswalks: any, but their own text is C.
envelope.citations: List of citation objects. Every document carries its own citations, not just a master bibliography. Fields: id, url, title, publisher, published_or_version_date, page, access_date, access_limitation.
envelope.version_notes: List of short strings: what changed, when, and why. Append, do not rewrite.
envelope.last_updated: YYYY-MM-DD of the last content change.

_instructions.sections.grade_and_subject: Names the grade and subject as the state does. Set organization to by_course when the state does not publish grade-by-grade (likely Grades 9-12). Never state a grade placement for a course as official unless the state does; label C otherwise.
_instructions.sections.domains: One entry per official strand/domain. standards[].id must be copied character for character. text_mode is 'exact' only when the text is a verbatim quote; use 'paraphrased' for anything shortened. label is always A here. citation_ids must exist in this document's citations.
_instructions.sections.assessment_notes: Include only if officially provided (for example Arizona essential standards getting more AASA test questions from 2025-26). Cite it. Otherwise null.
_instructions.sections.key_learning_outcomes: Our own teacher summary. Label C. Never mix official wording into it without a quote mark and citation.
_instructions.sections.version_and_update_notes: Which official version this file reflects and any known revisions.
quality_rules: Official sources only (FLDOE/CPALMS for Florida, azed.gov for Arizona).
Record a page number when the source has pages.
Do not guess; if a source is unreachable, say so in version_notes.
